papers.title: Circulating protein profiling identifies prognostic biomarkers in amyotrophic lateral Sclerosis
papers.translated_title: 循环蛋白谱分析识别肌萎缩侧索硬化症的预后生物标志物
papers.author: Klimovski, H.
papers.summary: Abstract Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by progressive motor neuron loss and marked clinical variability. Blood-based biomarkers offer a scalable approach to stratify patients and support therapeutic development. In a large-scale serum proteomic survival study of 730 patients with ALS from independent cohorts in Israel and the UK, we used complementary proteomic technologies, mass spectrometry and the Olink proximity extension assay (PEA), enabling cross-cohort and cross-platform evaluation of concordant protein effects. We identified serum proteins associated with survival in both cohorts. GSN, IGFBP2 and MEGF10 added prognostic information beyond clinical variables and neurofilament light chain (NfL). These circulating proteins are therefore candidate biomarkers for improved prognostic assessment that may lead to improved precision-medicine approa
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，以进行性运动神经元丢失和显著的临床异质性为特征。基于血液的生物标志物为患者分层和支持治疗开发提供了一种可扩展的方法。在一项针对来自以色列和英国独立队列的730例ALS患者的大规模血清蛋白质组生存研究中，我们采用了互补的蛋白质组学技术——质谱和Olink邻近延伸分析（PEA），从而实现了对一致蛋白质效应的跨队列和跨平台评估。我们在两个队列中均识别出与生存相关的血清蛋白质。GSN、IGFBP2和MEGF10在临床变量和神经丝轻链（NfL）之外提供了额外的预后信息。因此，这些循环蛋白质是用于改进预后评估的候选生物标志物，可能有助于实现改进的精准医学方法。

papers.title: Insights from a Decade of Hereditary Cancer Genetic Testing from India: A Retrospective Study
papers.translated_title: 印度遗传性癌症基因检测十年洞察：一项回顾性研究
papers.author: Menon, R.
papers.summary: Background Hereditary cancers account for approximately 5% to 10% of malignancies, with inherited susceptibility more frequently identified in individuals with early-onset disease or a significant family history. However, large-scale study of germline cancer susceptibility across multiple tumor types remains limited from India and the broader South Asian population. Methods We retrospectively analyzed 24,320 individuals who underwent germline hereditary cancer testing at MedGenome Labs Ltd., Bangalore, India, between 2016 and 2025. Testing was performed primarily using clinically validated multi-gene targeted next-generation sequencing (NGS) panels (N = 22,773), and for a subset of these cases were analyzed using multiplex ligation-dependent probe amplification (MLPA) (N = 4,524). Additionally, MLPA confirmatory test alone was done for 1,547 samples. The major cancer subgroups analyzed were breast (N = 10,292), ovarian (N = 3,935), colorectal (N = 1,267), prostate (N = 762), and endometrial (N = 539) cancers, with 2,764 asymptomatic individuals with a positive family history. Results The overall diagnostic yield was 23.9%, highest in colorectal (42.1%) followed by ovarian (31.6%), endometrial (22.3%), breast (20.3%), and prostate (8.7%) cancers. Family history of the corresponding cancer was associated with higher diagnostic yield across most major cancer types, whereas prostate cancer showed a higher yield among individuals reporting a family history of other cancers. Diagnostic yield generally decreased with increasing age in breast, colorectal, ovarian, and endometrial cancers, but increased with age in prostate cancer. BRCA1 and BRCA2 predominated in breast and ovarian cancers, mismatch repair genes in colorectal and endometrial cancers, and BRCA2 in prostate cancer. The recurrent BRCA1 c.68_69delAG (p.Glu23ValfsTer17) variant was identified in 351 individuals. The identified BRCA1 gene mutations correlated with functional consequence data from published mutagenesis study. Among breast cancer cases, the ER-/HER2- subtype showed the highest diagnostic yield (25.5%). Re-analysis of VUS using autoACMG classifier followed by manual review confirmed 277 of 443 samples (62.5%) as pathogenic/likely pathogenic (P/LP). Of the remaining VUS, 3.2% were classified as VUS-High using VUS-Grader tool. Additionally, manual review of 74 CNV-positive samples classified as VUS resulted in the reclassification of 41 (55.4%) as likely pathogenic, increasing the diagnostic yield by 1.4 percentage points. Among 4,524 individuals who underwent combined NGS and MLPA testing, CNVs were identified in 251 (5.5%), including 59 cases detected by MLPA but not by NGS. Conclusions This retrospective study represents the largest characterization of hereditary cancer susceptibility across major cancer types in South Asia, encompassing 24,320 samples. The findings support comprehensive multi-gene testing and population-adapted testing strategies to improve hereditary cancer risk assessment and precision oncology.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 遗传性癌症约占恶性肿瘤的5%至10%，在早发性疾病或具有显著家族史的个体中更常发现遗传易感性。然而，来自印度及更广泛南亚人群的跨多种肿瘤类型的种系癌症易感性大规模研究仍然有限。方法 我们回顾性分析了2016年至2025年间在印度班加罗尔MedGenome Labs Ltd.接受种系遗传性癌症检测的24,320名个体。检测主要使用经过临床验证的多基因靶向下一代测序（NGS） panel（N = 22,773），其中一部分病例使用多重连接依赖探针扩增（MLPA）进行分析（N = 4,524）。此外，对1,547份样本仅进行了MLPA确认检测。分析的主要癌症亚组为乳腺癌（N = 10,292）、卵巢癌（N = 3,935）、结直肠癌（N = 1,267）、前列腺癌（N = 762）和子宫内膜癌（N = 539），另有2,764名具有阳性家族史的无症状个体。结果 总体诊断率为23.9%，最高见于结直肠癌（42.1%），其次为卵巢癌（31.6%）、子宫内膜癌（22.3%）、乳腺癌（20.3%）和前列腺癌（8.7%）。相应癌症的家族史与大多数主要癌症类型中更高的诊断率相关，而前列腺癌在报告有其他癌症家族史的个体中显示出更高的检出率。乳腺癌、结直肠癌、卵巢癌和子宫内膜癌的诊断率通常随年龄增长而下降，但前列腺癌则随年龄增长而上升。BRCA1和BRCA2在乳腺癌和卵巢癌中占主导，错配修复基因在结直肠癌和子宫内膜癌中占主导，BRCA2在前列腺癌中占主导。复发性BRCA1 c.68_69delAG（p.Glu23ValfsTer17）变异在351名个体中被识别。所识别的BRCA1基因突变与已发表的诱变研究的功能后果数据相关。在乳腺癌病例中，ER-/HER2-亚型显示出最高的诊断率（25.5%）。使用autoACMG分类器对VUS重新分析后经人工审核，确认443份样本中的277份（62.5%）为致病性/可能致病性（P/LP）。在剩余VUS中，3.2%使用VUS-Grader工具被分类为VUS-High。此外，对74份被分类为VUS的CNV阳性样本进行人工审核，导致41份（55.4%）被重新分类为可能致病性，使诊断率提高了1.4个百分点。在4,524名接受NGS和MLPA联合检测的个体中，251名（5.5%）发现了CNV，其中59例由MLPA检测到但NGS未检测到。结论 本回顾性研究是南亚地区跨主要癌症类型遗传性癌症易感性的最大规模特征描述，涵盖24,320份样本。研究结果支持全面的多基因检测和适应当地人群的检测策略，以改善遗传性癌症风险评估和精准肿瘤学。

papers.title: Contextual DNA methylation QTLs link adversity responsivity to immune changes and evolutionary trade-offs
papers.translated_title: 情境依赖性DNA甲基化QTL将逆境反应性与免疫变化及进化权衡联系起来
papers.author: Czamara, D.
papers.summary: Childhood adversity (CA) is one of the strongest risk factors for psychiatric but also numerous medical disorders, yet only a subset of exposed individuals develops these outcomes. Gene-by-environment interactions have long been proposed to account for this variability, but identifying the specific variants involved has proven difficult in studies using clinical endpoints. We therefore mapped interaction effects between genetic variants and CA at the molecular level, testing for contextual methylation quantitative trait loci (contmeQTLs) in peripheral blood from 3,471 adolescents and adults across six cohorts. Meta-analysis identified 5,120 contmeQTLs, >99% acting in cis, of which 20% were already detectable in three independent childhood cohorts (N=780), indicating that these effects emerge in temporal proximity to exposure. ContmeQTLs were enriched for immune-related pathways, particularly the major histocompatibility (MHC)/human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-complex, were associated with altered expression of HLA and other immune regulators, and captured disease risk beyond that explained by baseline meQTLs. A polygenic interaction responsivity score, constructed from contmeQTL variants, predicted both a larger acute transcriptional response to infection and a greater shift towards a pro-inflammatory plasma profile in CA-exposed adults, including in UK Biobank. Using ancient DNA, we found that these responsive alleles have been under positive selection, identifying molecular responsivity to adversity as an evolutionarily shaped trait whose benefit under acute challenge is accompanied by liability to immune-mediated and psychiatric disease.
papers.translated_summary: 童年逆境（CA）是精神疾病以及众多躯体疾病最强的风险因素之一，但仅有部分暴露个体最终出现这些结局。基因-环境交互作用长期以来被认为可以解释这种差异性，然而在使用临床终点指标的研究中，识别所涉及的具体变异一直十分困难。因此，我们在分子水平上绘制了遗传变异与童年逆境之间的交互效应图谱，在来自六个队列的3,471名青少年和成人的外周血中检测情境依赖性甲基化数量性状位点（contmeQTL）。荟萃分析识别出5,120个contmeQTL，其中超过99%以顺式方式发挥作用，20%已在三个独立的儿童期队列（N=780）中可被检测到，表明这些效应在时间上与暴露相近时出现。contmeQTL富集于免疫相关通路，尤其是主要组织相容性复合体（MHC）/人类白细胞抗原（HLA）复合体区域，与HLA及其他免疫调节因子的表达改变相关，并且捕获了基线meQTL所无法解释的疾病风险。基于contmeQTL变异构建的多基因交互反应性评分，能够预测童年逆境暴露成人对感染的更大急性转录反应以及向促炎血浆谱的更大偏移，包括在UK Biobank中。利用古DNA，我们发现这些反应性等位基因一直受到正选择，从而将对外界逆境的分子反应性识别为一种经进化塑造的性状，其在急性挑战下的获益伴随着对免疫介导疾病和精神疾病的易感性。

papers.title: Community pharmacy responses to online reviews: a national cross-sectional study
papers.translated_title: 社区药房对在线评论的回应：一项全国性横断面研究
papers.author: Sambore, D.
papers.summary: Objectives: Online reviews constitute a source of information on the experience of users in community pharmacies. The way in which pharmacists engage with them remains poorly documented. The objective was to describe the frequency, determinants, and content of the responses provided by French pharmacy teams to reviews published on Google Maps. Methods: Cross-sectional observational study. Public reviews from nearly all French community pharmacies (approximately 20 000) were collected automatically between September and October 2026. For each review, the rating, the text of the review, the time since its publication, and the text of the response, if it existed, were collected. Factors associated with the response were studied using logistic regression. Sentiment of the reviews and the tone of the responses were automatically coded according to a predefined grid. The presence of reviews generated by artificial intelligence, as well as potential interventions on the ratings, were explored.\newline Results: In total, 1 008 024 extractions (729 521 reviews and 278 504 responses) concerning 19 985 pharmacies were analysed. A response was present for 38% of reviews and 67.5% of pharmacies had responded at least once. The response rate was higher for negative reviews (one or two stars) than for positive reviews (five stars) (adjusted OR 1.35; 95% CI [1.33--1.38]; adjusted risk difference +3.6 percentage points; 95% CI [3.3--3.8]), and these responses were approximately twice as long (adjusted geometric mean ratio 3.03; 95% CI [3.01--3.06]). The tone of the responses was very widely judged to be appropriate. Comments generated by artificial intelligence seem to be appearing progressively and represent approximately 3-4% in 2026. The removal of poor ratings appears to be marginal. Conclusions: Community pharmacists regularly and appropriately respond to online reviews, including, and in particular, less positive ones. These results could serve in the development of specific professional recommendations aimed at securing this practice.
papers.translated_summary: 目标：在线评论构成了社区药房用户经验的信息来源。药师如何回应这些评论仍缺乏充分记录。目标是描述法国药房团队对Google Maps上发表的评论所提供回复的频率、决定因素和内容。方法：横断面观察性研究。于2026年9月至10月间自动收集了近所有法国社区药房（约20 000家）的公开评论。对于每条评论，收集评分、评论文本、自发表以来的时间以及回复文本（如存在）。使用逻辑回归研究与回复相关的因素。根据预定义网格自动编码评论的情感和回复的语气。探索了人工智能生成的评论的存在以及对评分可能的干预。结果：共分析了涉及19 985家药房的1 008 024条提取记录（729 521条评论和278 504条回复）。38%的评论存在回复，67.5%的药房至少回复过一次。负面评论（一星或两星）的回复率高于正面评论（五星）（调整OR 1.35；95% CI [1.33--1.38]；调整风险差+3.6个百分点；95% CI [3.3--3.8]），且这些回复的长度约为前者的两倍（调整几何均值比3.03；95% CI [3.01--3.06]）。回复的语气被广泛判定为适当。人工智能生成的评论似乎正在逐步出现，2026年约占3-4%。差评的删除似乎是边缘性的。结论：社区药师定期且适当地回复在线评论，包括且尤其是较不积极的评论。这些结果可用于制定旨在保障这一实践的具体专业建议。

papers.title: Plausibly Causal Plasma Proteins in Psychiatric Disorders: A Proteogenomic Appraisal
papers.translated_title: 精神病学障碍中可能具有因果关系的血浆蛋白：一项蛋白质基因组学评估
papers.author: Margelyte, R.
papers.summary: Importance: Large-scale plasma proteomic studies have linked hundreds of proteins to psychiatric disorders, but it is unclear which reflect causal biology rather than confounding or consequences of illness. Objective: To determine which plasma proteins associated with depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, and psychotic disorders have genetic evidence of a causal role. Design, Setting, and Participants: This proteogenomic study combined genetic analyses with cross-sectional and longitudinal analyses in the UK Biobank (UKB) cohort (N=52,615). Associations of 2,923 plasma proteins were tested using two-sample Mendelian randomisation (MR) and genetic colocalisation with common-variant protein quantitative trait loci (pQTLs) from the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (N=34,557). Findings were appraised via a rule-based framework combining instrument validity with genetic analyses using blood and brain expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) and rare-variant MR. Exposures: Measured and genetically proxied plasma protein levels. Main Outcomes and Measures: Prevalent and incident diagnoses of depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, and psychotic disorders; summary statistics from genome-wide association studies (GWAS) for depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, and schizophrenia. Results: A total of 1,685 proteins were involved in protein-disorder associations in UKB after multiple testing correction, of which 26 proteins (32 protein-disorder pairs) met both MR and colocalisation (MR false discovery rate <0.05 and posterior probability of colocalisation [≥]0.8). After independent genetic validation, 9 disorder-protein pairs involving 7 proteins (CD40, ADAM22, CDHR1, PDIA3, SEMA3F, DSG3, and DDR1) met criteria for credible causal evidence, led by CD40, an immune signalling receptor, for schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. Specifically, higher genetically predicted CD40 levels were associated with lower risk of schizophrenia (odds ratio [OR] 0.90; 95%CI 0.85-0.95) and bipolar disorder (OR 0.89; 95%CI 0.84-0.95), supported by directionally concordant colocalised brain eQTL and rare-variant MR evidence. Conclusions and Relevance: Few plasma protein associations with major psychiatric disorders had credible genetic support for causality, demonstrating that multi-layer appraisal across molecular layers, tissues, and genetic variant classes is required before nominating proteomic targets. CD40, an immune receptor targeted by drugs in clinical development, showed robust protective genetic support across schizophrenia and bipolar disorder, warranting focused mechanistic and therapeutic investigation.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：大规模血浆蛋白质组学研究已将数百种蛋白质与精神疾病联系起来，但尚不清楚哪些反映因果生物学而非混杂因素或疾病后果。目的：确定哪些与抑郁、焦虑、双相障碍和精神病性障碍相关的血浆蛋白质具有因果作用的遗传学证据。设计、设置和参与者：本蛋白质基因组学研究将遗传分析与英国生物银行（UKB）队列（N=52,615）中的横断面和纵向分析相结合。使用两样本孟德尔随机化（MR）和遗传共定位，对2,923种血浆蛋白质与来自英国生物银行制药蛋白质组学项目（N=34,557）的常见变异蛋白质数量性状位点（pQTL）的关联进行了检验。研究结果通过基于规则的框架进行评估，该框架结合了工具变量有效性与使用血液和脑表达数量性状位点（eQTL）及罕见变异MR的遗传分析。暴露：测量的和遗传代理的血浆蛋白质水平。主要结局和指标：抑郁、焦虑、双相障碍和精神病性障碍的现患和新发诊断；抑郁、焦虑、双相障碍和精神分裂症的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）汇总统计数据。结果：多重检验校正后，UKB中有1,685种蛋白质涉及蛋白质-障碍关联，其中26种蛋白质（32个蛋白质-障碍配对）同时满足MR和共定位标准（MR错误发现率<0.05且共定位后验概率≥0.8）。经过独立遗传验证后，涉及7种蛋白质（CD40、ADAM22、CDHR1、PDIA3、SEMA3F、DSG3和DDR1）的9个障碍-蛋白质配对符合可信因果证据标准，其中以免疫信号受体CD40对精神分裂症和双相障碍的作用为首。具体而言，遗传预测的CD40水平较高与精神分裂症风险较低（比值比[OR] 0.90；95%CI 0.85-0.95）和双相障碍风险较低（OR 0.89；95%CI 0.84-0.95）相关，并得到方向一致的共定位脑eQTL和罕见变异MR证据的支持。结论与意义：与主要精神疾病相关的血浆蛋白质关联中，很少有具有可信的因果遗传学支持，这表明在提名蛋白质组学靶点之前，需要在分子层面、组织和遗传变异类别上进行多层评估。CD40是一种正在临床开发中被药物靶向的免疫受体，在精神分裂症和双相障碍中显示出稳健的保护性遗传学支持，值得进行有针对性的机制和治疗研究。

papers.title: DNA capture and amplicon enrichment approaches for next-generation sequencing of Mycoplasma genitalium directly from clinical samples
papers.translated_title: 直接从临床样本中进行生殖支原体下一代测序的DNA捕获与扩增子富集方法
papers.author: Guiraud, J.
papers.summary: Direct genome sequencing of Mycoplasma genitalium from clinical specimens is challenging due to the organism's low bacterial load. We developed and compared two DNA enrichment strategies - amplicon-based and hybridisation capture-based - coupled with next-generation sequencing, and assessed the suitability of DNA capture for whole-genome sequencing and high-resolution molecular typing. The enrichment approaches, RNA bait hybridisation and targeted sequence amplification, were combined with paired-end sequencing on the Illumina iSeq 100. Method performance was evaluated in 89 M. genitalium-positive specimens across five genomic loci: 23S and 16S rRNA, and parC and gyrA for macrolide, tetracycline, and fluoroquinolone resistance, respectively, and mgpB for phylogenetic analysis. Regarding antimicrobial resistance (AMR) determinants, the multiplex amplicon sequencing method demonstrated the highest sensitivity, at 93.3-98.9%. Although < 50% of samples were characterised using DNA capture, concordance between the two methods was excellent. Using DNA capture, 24.7% of specimens achieved a minimum coverage of 95% at 1x depth. Sequencing success was inversely correlated with human DNA contamination and the presence of low-quality reads. Whole-genome single-nucleotide polymorphism analysis provided higher discriminatory power than multi-locus sequence typing schemes and confirmed the clonality of multidrug-resistant M. genitalium strains belonging to the mgpB genotype 159. In conclusion, targeted amplicon-based enrichment is the most accurate and reliable approach for epidemiological studies focused on AMR and mgpB typing, whereas DNA capture is valuable for generating comprehensive genomic data from selected M. genitalium-positive specimens.
papers.translated_summary: 由于生殖支原体在临床样本中的细菌载量低，直接对其进行基因组测序具有挑战性。我们开发并比较了两种DNA富集策略——基于扩增子的方法和基于杂交捕获的方法——并结合下一代测序技术，评估了DNA捕获在全基因组测序和高分辨率分子分型中的适用性。富集方法包括RNA探针杂交和靶向序列扩增，并与Illumina iSeq 100平台上的双端测序相结合。在89份生殖支原体阳性样本中，针对五个基因组位点评估了方法性能：23S和16S rRNA，以及分别用于大环内酯类、四环素类和氟喹诺酮类耐药性的parC和gyrA，还有用于系统发育分析的mgpB。关于抗微生物药物耐药性决定因素，多重扩增子测序方法表现出最高的灵敏度，为93.3%至98.9%。尽管使用DNA捕获仅对不足50%的样本进行了表征，但两种方法之间的一致性极好。使用DNA捕获时，24.7%的样本在1倍深度下达到了95%的最低覆盖度。测序成功率与人类DNA污染和低质量读数的存在呈负相关。全基因组单核苷酸多态性分析提供了比多位点序列分型方案更高的分辨能力，并证实了属于mgpB基因型159的多重耐药生殖支原体菌株的克隆性。总之，基于靶向扩增子的富集是专注于抗微生物药物耐药性和mgpB分型的流行病学研究中最准确和可靠的方法，而DNA捕获对于从选定的生殖支原体阳性样本中生成全面的基因组数据具有重要价值。

papers.title: Functional analysis of NANOS protein variants identified in men with infertility employing zebrafish embryos
papers.translated_title: 应用斑马鱼胚胎对不育男性中鉴定出的NANOS蛋白变异体进行功能分析
papers.author: Madiwale, S.
papers.summary: Study questionAre vertebrate NANOS proteins associated with human fertility, and can a rapid in vivo assay in zebrafish be established to evaluate the biological activity of human NANOS variants? Summary answerCombining a rapid in vivo assay we developed for Nanos protein activity and patient-derived genetic data, we identified NANOS variants that could contribute to male infertility. What is known alreadyMale infertility affects approximately 17% of the population, but linking specific gene variants to this condition remains challenging. NANOS proteins are essential regulators of germ cell development in different model organisms; however, a rapid and robust in vivo assay for evaluating their activity in the context of human male infertility is currently lacking. Study design, size, durationExome/genome data from 3,338 men included in the Male Reproductive Genomics (MERGE) cohort were examined in this study. Of these, 2038 men showed severely impaired spermatogenesis but were otherwise healthy. Ninety-Six men with intact spermatogenesis were included in the study as controls. Additionally, the study included a targeted analysis of NANOS variants in 44 patients from the IMIGC cohort. Participants/materials, setting, methodsThe exome/genome data were screened for rare, stop-gain, frameshift, splice site, as well as missense variants in NANOS1, NANOS2, and NANOS3. Human amino acid substitutions were introduced at the corresponding positions in the zebrafish proteins. Ectopic co-expression of wild-type Dnd1 and Nanos3 in zebrafish embryos induces a germ cell-like fate in somatic cells, resulting in severe developmental defects and embryonic lethality. Based on this principle, we established a rapid in vivo assay in which wild-type Dnd1 was co-expressed with wild-type or variant Nanos2 and Nanos3 proteins in live zebrafish embryos, expecting early embryonic death if a variant protein is functional. This assay was used to evaluate the activity of NANOS2 and NANOS3 variants identified in men with infertility. Main results and the role of chanceIn human exome/genome sequencing data, we identified one heterozygous missense variant in NANOS2 and two heterozygous missense variants in NANOS3. The function of the variants was examined in the zebrafish using the in vivo assay we developed. Co-expression of wild-type Dnd1 with selected Nanos2 or Nanos3 variants identified in infertile men resulted in defects in induction of the germ cell-like phenotype, demonstrating the power of the biological readout for evaluating the potential effects of patient-derived variants on NANOS protein activity. Together, our analysis enabled the evaluation of single nucleotide variants, whose impact on protein function is difficult to predict, and allowed us to distinguish variants with little or no effect on protein function from those that strongly reduce activity and may potentially contribute to infertility. Limitations, reasons for cautionThe assay requires access to zebrafish embryos and basic imaging equipment. Although the functional conservation of NANOS proteins between zebrafish and humans is supported by previous studies, species-specific differences may influence protein activity. Therefore, the zebrafish assay should be considered one component of a broader framework for evaluating NANOS variants as contributing factor for infertility. Wider implications of the findingsUsing NANOS2 and NANOS3 as examples, we demonstrate that integrating clinical genetic data with functional cell and developmental biology can help establish links between candidate disease genes and human fertility. This strategy may apply to other germline-specific genes whose ectopic expression produces measurable developmental phenotypes in zebrafish embryos. papers.translated_summary: 研究问题：脊椎动物NANOS蛋白是否与人类生育力相关，能否建立一种斑马鱼快速体内试验来评估人类NANOS变异的生物学活性？简要回答：结合我们开发的用于Nanos蛋白活性的快速体内试验和患者来源的遗传数据，我们鉴定出可能贡献于男性不育的NANOS变异。已知情况：男性不育影响约17%的人群，但将特定基因变异与该病症联系起来仍然具有挑战性。NANOS蛋白是不同模式生物中生殖细胞发育的关键调控因子；然而，目前缺乏一种快速且稳健的体内试验来评估其在人类男性不育背景下的活性。研究设计、规模、持续时间：本研究检查了男性生殖基因组学（MERGE）队列中3,338名男性的外显子组/基因组数据。其中，2038名男性表现出严重受损的精子发生，但在其他方面健康。96名精子发生完整的男性作为对照纳入研究。此外，该研究还包括对IMIGC队列中44名患者的NANOS变异进行靶向分析。参与者/材料、环境、方法：对外显子组/基因组数据筛查NANOS1、NANOS2和NANOS3中的罕见无义突变、移码、剪接位点以及错义变异。在斑马鱼蛋白的相应位置引入人类氨基酸替换。在斑马鱼胚胎中异位共表达野生型Dnd1和Nanos3可诱导体细胞产生生殖细胞样命运，导致严重发育缺陷和胚胎致死。基于这一原理，我们建立了一种快速体内试验，在活体斑马鱼胚胎中将野生型Dnd1与野生型或变异型Nanos2和Nanos3蛋白共表达，预期如果变异蛋白具有功能，则会导致早期胚胎死亡。该试验用于评估在不育男性中鉴定的NANOS2和NANOS3变异的活性。主要结果和机会的作用：在人类外显子组/基因组测序数据中，我们鉴定了NANOS2中的一个杂合错义变异和NANOS3中的两个杂合错义变异。使用我们开发的体内试验在斑马鱼中检查了这些变异的功能。将野生型Dnd1与从不育男性中选出的Nanos2或Nanos3变异共表达，导致生殖细胞样表型诱导缺陷，证明了该生物学读数在评估患者来源变异对NANOS蛋白活性潜在影响方面的效力。总之，我们的分析使得能够评估单核苷酸变异，这些变异对蛋白功能的影响难以预测，并使我们能够区分对蛋白功能影响很小或没有影响的变异与强烈降低活性并可能潜在贡献于不育的变异。局限性、谨慎的原因：该试验需要获取斑马鱼胚胎和基础成像设备。尽管先前研究支持NANOS蛋白在斑马鱼和人类之间的功能保守性，但物种特异性差异可能影响蛋白活性。因此，斑马鱼试验应被视为评估NANOS变异作为不育贡献因素的更广泛框架的一个组成部分。发现的更广泛意义：以NANOS2和NANOS3为例，我们证明将临床遗传数据与功能细胞和发育生物学相结合，有助于建立候选疾病基因与人类生育力之间的联系。该策略可能适用于其他生殖系特异性基因，其异位表达在斑马鱼胚胎中产生可测量的发育表型。研究资助/竞争利益：我们感谢西班牙卫生部Instituto Carlos III-FIS FONDOS FEDER（资助号PI23/00425）、德国研究基金会（DFG）对E.R.的资助（RA 863/17-1、RA 863/18-1）、对E.R.、C.F.和F.T.的资助（男性生殖细胞临床研究单元，CRU 326，项目号329621271）、对S.K.、C.F.和F.T.的资助（合作研究中心Reproduction.MS，SFB 1748，项目号549467913）、联邦研究、技术和空间部（BMFTR）青年科学家研究中心ReproTrack.MS对S.K.和F.T.的资助（项目号01GR2303），以及明斯特大学医学院的资助。作者声明无竞争利益。试验注册号：不适用。

papers.title: A cerebrospinal fluid metabolic signature of recovery in normal pressure hydrocephalus
papers.translated_title: 正常压力脑积水恢复的脑脊液代谢特征
papers.author: Duan, L.
papers.summary: Understanding the biological determinants of recovery of neurological function remains a major challenge. Normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH) is characterized by urinary incontinence, gait impairment and cognitive decline. Notably, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) drainage can substantially improve symptoms, making NPH one of the few potentially reversible causes of dementia. However, postoperative benefit varies considerably between patients, and reliable preoperative predictors are lacking, leaving patients exposed to invasive intervention with uncertain likelihood of clinical benefit. We therefore asked whether preoperative CSF metabolic profiles capture biological states associated with neurological recovery. We studied a single-center cohort of 86 patients with NPH (mean age 74.7 years, range 59-90; 44 men, 42 women). We analyzed ventricular CSF from patients undergoing shunt surgery by semi-targeted (n = 42) and targeted (n = 55) mass spectrometry, with additional lumbar CSF (n = 29) and plasma (n = 33). Pathways identified in the discovery cohort were summarized as indices and tested in the targeted cohort on a locked dataset with a prespecified statistical analysis plan. A one-carbon/redox index, combining transsulfuration and choline metabolites, was associated with the number of symptom domains improved at 3 months (odds ratio 0.49 per SD, 95% CI 0.24-0.92; false discovery rate 0.051), most strongly for cognition, where lower index values accompanied improvement. Transcripts of the one-carbon pathway in CSF extracellular vesicles of the same patients shifted in the same direction (permutation p = 0.023; not significant after correction). Under nested cross-validation, a sparse metabolite model distinguished patients who improved cognitively, both in a leave-one-out implementation of our initial pipeline (AUC 0.79; permutation p = 0.028) and in the locked repeated 5-fold protocol (AUC 0.70; p = 0.046 after correction for model choice), and adding the prespecified indices to clinical covariates improved cognitive prediction; the prespecified full-metabolome model and models for gait and urinary outcomes did not exceed chance. These results point to one-carbon and choline metabolism as a candidate biological correlate of cognitive recovery after shunt surgery, to be tested in a prospective validation study.
papers.translated_summary: 理解神经功能恢复的生物学决定因素仍然是一项重大挑战。正常压力脑积水（NPH）以尿失禁、步态障碍和认知功能下降为特征。值得注意的是，脑脊液（CSF）引流可以显著改善症状，使NPH成为少数可能可逆的痴呆病因之一。然而，术后获益在患者之间差异相当大，且缺乏可靠的术前预测指标，使患者暴露于侵入性干预之下而临床获益的可能性不确定。因此，我们提出术前CSF代谢谱是否能捕捉与神经功能恢复相关的生物学状态。我们研究了一个单中心NPH患者队列，共86例（平均年龄74.7岁，范围59-90；男44例，女42例）。我们通过半靶向（n = 42）和靶向（n = 55）质谱分析接受分流手术患者的脑室CSF，并额外分析腰椎CSF（n = 29）和血浆（n = 33）。在发现队列中鉴定的通路被归纳为指数，并在锁定数据集上以预设的统计分析方案在靶向队列中进行检验。一个一碳/氧化还原指数，结合转硫途径和胆碱代谢物，与3个月时改善的症状域数量相关（每标准差比值比0.49，95% CI 0.24-0.92；错误发现率0.051），其中与认知的相关性最强，较低的指数值伴随改善。同一患者CSF细胞外囊泡中一碳通路的转录本向相同方向变化（置换检验p = 0.023；校正后不显著）。在嵌套交叉验证下，一个稀疏代谢物模型能够区分认知改善的患者，无论是在我们初始流程的留一法实现中（AUC 0.79；置换检验p = 0.028），还是在锁定的重复5折方案中（AUC 0.70；模型选择校正后p = 0.046），并且将预设指数加入临床协变量改善了认知预测；预设的全代谢组模型以及步态和泌尿结局的模型未超过随机水平。这些结果指向一碳和胆碱代谢作为分流手术后认知恢复的候选生物学相关因素，有待在前瞻性验证研究中检验。

papers.title: Adapting Clinical Event Annotation to Dutch Primary Care: An Event Annotation Framework for Post-Acute Infection Syndromes
papers.translated_title: 将临床事件标注适配于荷兰初级保健：针对急性感染后综合征的事件标注框架
papers.author: Mazzucato, S.
papers.summary: Clinical natural language processing (NLP) relies on language-specific corpora, which remain scarce for Dutch primary care. This limits the use of NLP to study post-acute infection syndromes (PAIS), such as post-COVID condition, as relevant symptoms and their temporal context are often documented in free-text general practitioner (GP) records rather than structured codes. The COVID-19 Annotated Clinical Text (CACT) framework was developed to identify COVID-19 diagnoses and related symptoms in English-language clinical notes, each represented as an event: a text span linked to its context, such as negation, timing and certainty. We translated and adapted CACT for Dutch primary care, extending its scope beyond COVID-19 to PAIS and other relevant infections and diagnoses, with annotation rules tailored to the four sections of Dutch GP notes (SOEP: Subjective, Objective, Evaluation, Plan). The revised framework distinguishes symptoms, acute infections, PAIS and other relevant diagnoses, and captures 11 types of supporting diagnostic evidence, including laboratory tests or physical examinations. It also differentiates uncertain diagnoses ('possibly post-COVID') from conditions mentioned but not asserted (e.g. a patient's fear of long COVID). In a pilot of 200 GP notes independently annotated by two annotators, overall span-level agreement over six core categories (symptoms, diagnoses, negation, evidence, timing and vital signs) was F1 = 0.51 (95% CI [0.47, 0.55]). Agreement increased to F1 = 0.78 [0.75, 0.80] when restricted to text spans marked by both annotators, suggesting that disagreement primarily concerned whether a mention was annotated at all, not which category it received. Future research should evaluate which parts of the revised framework generalise beyond Dutch primary care and PAIS.
papers.translated_summary: 临床自然语言处理（NLP）依赖于特定语言的语料库，而荷兰初级保健领域的此类语料库仍然稀缺。这限制了使用NLP研究急性感染后综合征（PAIS），如新冠感染后状况，因为相关症状及其时间背景通常记录在全科医生（GP）的自由文本记录中，而非结构化编码中。COVID-19标注临床文本（CACT）框架的开发旨在识别英文临床记录中的COVID-19诊断及相关症状，每个症状表示为一个事件：一个文本片段及其关联的上下文，如否定、时间和确定性。我们翻译并改编了CACT以适用于荷兰初级保健，将其范围从COVID-19扩展到PAIS及其他相关感染和诊断，并针对荷兰全科医生记录的四部分（SOEP：主观、客观、评估、计划）定制了标注规则。修订后的框架区分症状、急性感染、PAIS及其他相关诊断，并捕获11类支持性诊断证据，包括实验室检查或体格检查。它还将不确定的诊断（“可能新冠后”）与提及但未断言的状况（例如患者对长新冠的恐惧）区分开来。在由两名标注者独立标注200份全科医生记录的试点中，六个核心类别（症状、诊断、否定、证据、时间和生命体征）的总体片段级一致性为F1 = 0.51（95% CI [0.47, 0.55]）。当仅限于两名标注者均标记的文本片段时，一致性提高至F1 = 0.78 [0.75, 0.80]，表明分歧主要在于某提及是否被标注，而非其被归入哪个类别。未来研究应评估修订框架的哪些部分可推广至荷兰初级保健和PAIS之外的领域。

papers.title: Neural networks for dengue forecasting: a systematic review
papers.translated_title: 用于登革热预测的神经网络：一项系统综述
papers.author: Piva, L. L. d. S.
papers.summary: Background: Early dengue forecasts are an important tool for disease mitigation, and neural networks (NNs) are powerful predictive models that have contributed to many areas of public health. We reviewed NN applications in the dengue forecasting literature to inform model design for future studies. Methods: Following PRISMA guidelines, we systematically searched Web of Science/Knowledge, Scopus, PubMed, and Science Direct up to September 2025 for studies using NNs to forecast dengue in human populations, retrieving 628 records. After removing duplicates, four inclusion and two exclusion criteria were applied: articles had to be in English, implement NN or deep learning techniques, predict dengue fever incidence or risk, and clearly state data sources, processing steps, network parameters, and architectures. Results: Sixty two papers were included and summarized by relative performance of neural networks and comparator models, architectures and hyper-parameters, choices of input features, geographic spread, and model transparency. Most studies (35 out of 62) implemented shallow feed-forward neural networks, using historical dengue incidence and climate variables as the most common input features, with 43 appearances. Target variables were dengue cases, severity and hotspots, and risk of outbreak, with model selection and evaluation approach being non uniform. Most studies (25) used granular observations at the city level or its subdivisions, while also commonly employing data from weekly measurements (35 out of 62). Performance of neural networks relative to comparators, such as tree-based supervised models, varied across study contexts. We found that 63% of studies included such models in their baseline; of these, approximately half found neural networks to outperform the baseline, although most do not include statistical comparisons. Conclusions: The studies suggest that neural networks, although useful in specific scenarios, are not consistently found to be superior to simpler predictive models, especially tree-based machine learning methods.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：早期登革热预测是疾病缓解的重要工具，神经网络（NNs）是强大的预测模型，已在公共卫生的许多领域做出贡献。我们综述了登革热预测文献中的神经网络应用，以为未来研究的模型设计提供参考。方法：遵循PRISMA指南，我们系统检索了Web of Science/Knowledge、Scopus、PubMed和Science Direct截至2025年9月的文献，以查找使用神经网络预测人群登革热的研究，共检索到628条记录。去除重复后，应用四项纳入标准和两项排除标准：文章须为英文，实施神经网络或深度学习技术，预测登革热发病率或风险，并明确说明数据来源、处理步骤、网络参数和架构。结果：共纳入62篇论文，并按神经网络与对照模型的相对性能、架构与超参数、输入特征选择、地理分布和模型透明度进行总结。大多数研究（62项中的35项）实施了浅层前馈神经网络，使用历史登革热发病率和气候变量作为最常见的输入特征，共出现43次。目标变量为登革热病例、严重程度和热点以及暴发风险，模型选择和评估方法不统一。大多数研究（25项）使用城市或其分区层面的精细观测数据，同时也常用每周测量数据（62项中的35项）。神经网络相对于对照模型（如基于树的监督模型）的性能因研究背景而异。我们发现63%的研究在基线中纳入了此类模型；其中约一半发现神经网络优于基线，尽管大多数未包括统计比较。结论：这些研究表明，神经网络虽然在特定场景中有用，但并未一致发现其优于更简单的预测模型，尤其是基于树的机器学习方法。
